purpose: Ingest sparse-state discoveries spanning evidence-synthesis rigor, physical random-bit generation, biological material custody, vulnerability-scanner metadata, public demographic data and low-value catalog controls.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, material record or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Preprint/final-publication copies, catalog/search mirrors and vulnerability-scanner pages for the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Article IDs, plasmid IDs, plugin IDs, geographic IDs and catalog IDs can be useful to Worldshepherd but carry zero automatic Glob evidence; physical evidence requires the digits to encode a verified physical quantity or relation.

sources.title: Digital Tools’ Effectiveness on Physical Activity Outcomes in Children and Adolescents: Umbrella Review
sources.note: Use PRIOR/PRISMA-S review structure, AMSTAR 2 quality assessment, RoB 2 and explicit heterogeneity reporting as an evidence-synthesis template for Worldshepherd multi-study reviews. 75769 is the article identifier.

sources.title: Atmospheric pressure air microplasma current time series for true random bit generation
sources.note: Use physical entropy acquisition, binarization and NIST SP 800-22 validation as a hardware-randomness benchmark. The authors report successful test configurations up to 100 MS/s. 77956 is a DOI component, not the entropy value.

sources.title: ZAP70 gRNA (BRDN0001487050)
sources.note: Use deposited-material identity, sequence-map, publication, depositor, ordering and permitted-use metadata as another governed research-asset custody pattern. 77956 is the catalog number.

sources.title: Data Commons place zip/95607
sources.authority: Data Commons with Census/CDC source facets
sources.note: Use source-faceted public demographic/economic/health data and API-addressable geographic identity as an ingestion and provenance test corpus. 95607 is a ZIP/geographic identifier.

sources.title: 8 Escudos — Ferdinand VI — Guatemala
sources.note: Retain as a low-value catalog-namespace control showing exact target recurrence in a structured but unrelated domain. The record includes composition, weight, mint and catalog cross-references; 75039 is the catalog ID.

information_updates.finding: The 2026 umbrella review explicitly separates systematic-review quality, RCT risk of bias, intervention heterogeneity and effectiveness rates. Worldshepherd reviews should similarly report source-quality distributions and heterogeneity rather than collapse mixed evidence into a single success percentage.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Methodological transfer only; the physical-activity intervention results themselves are not generalized to Worldshepherd.

information_updates.finding: The microplasma TRBG work provides a validation sequence of physical entropy source -> time-series acquisition -> binarization -> standardized statistical testing across sampling rates/configurations. This is a useful template for any future Worldshepherd hardware entropy source.
information_updates.claims_boundary: No claim is made that passing NIST SP 800-22 alone proves unpredictability or cryptographic suitability; independent entropy assessment remains required.

information_updates.finding: Target 77956 now occurs independently as a scientific DOI component, a biological material catalog ID and a security-scanner plugin ID. The three unrelated namespaces provide a particularly clear collision-control example.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Cross-namespace multiplicity is a retrieval/collision property and carries zero physical Glob weight.

next_actions: Continue analyzer-driven sparse-state multiplicity scans, prioritizing states with one record or one namespace.
Adopt evidence-synthesis quality/heterogeneity fields and physical-entropy validation sequences as candidate Worldshepherd methodology where applicable.
Retain low-value structured catalog hits in the negative-control corpus instead of discarding them.
Continue same-system physical topology and relational verification with fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls.
